stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Job Agent 2.9.2 beta: manual REVIEW preparation no longer blocked by the score-65 threshold; supported-source, verified-evidence, experience, location and manual final-submit protections remain in place. StartupJobs detects incomplete/error listing pages and reports source failures accurately instead of claiming no vacancies. A new reversible Inactive Vacancies archive hides closed jobs from active results and subsequent search/preparation runs, with a restore option and preserved application history. Release smoke checks and regression tests updated.
